description: STM32F446 peripheral registers at their addresses, reset values and field access, and its interrupt numbers, converted by tools/importers/svd2regs.py from STMicroelectronics' STM32F446.svd (version 1.9, from ST's STM32F4 SVD pack v2.0 as archived by modm-io/cmsis-svd-stm32), Copyright (c) 2024 STMicroelectronics, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 (LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt). Where the SVD and RM0390 (the STM32F446 reference manual) disagree, the manual's value is used; the corrections are listed in source. DBG is the DBGMCU block on the external private peripheral bus.
source: converted from STMicroelectronics STM32F446.svd v1.9 by tools/importers/svd2regs.py; split fields joined: RCC.PLLCFGR.PLLM, RCC.PLLCFGR.PLLN, RCC.PLLCFGR.PLLP, RCC.PLLCFGR.PLLQ, RCC.CFGR.SW, RCC.CFGR.SWS; fields corrected from the reference manual: RCC.PLLCFGR.PLLR:28:3, RCC.CR.PLLSAION:28:1, RCC.CR.PLLSAIRDY:29:1:r, FLASH.ACR.LATENCY:0:4; reset values corrected from the reference manual: GPIOA.OSPEEDR=0x0C000000, USART6.SR=0x000000C0, UART4.SR=0x000000C0, DBG.DBGMCU_IDCODE=0x10006421; interrupts reassigned from the reference manual: TIM9=TIM1_BRK_TIM9; TIM10=TIM1_UP_TIM10; TIM11=TIM1_TRG_COM_TIM11; TIM12=TIM8_BRK_TIM12; TIM13=TIM8_UP_TIM13; TIM14=TIM8_TRG_COM_TIM14; I2C1=I2C1_EV,I2C1_ER; FMPI2C=FMPI2C1,FMPI2C1_error; ADC1=ADC; ADC2=ADC; ADC3=ADC; DAC=TIM6_DAC; PWR=PVD
